-	script	MobExtraDrops	-1,{
OnNPCKillEvent:
	// Configuration
	// How it works? - Incubus (1374) will drop 28307 (Item ID) at a rate of 75 (0.75%)
	setarray .@MobID[0],1631,1261,1275,1736,1734,1688,1143,1115,1096,1418,2018,1093,1117,1259,1219,1837,1586,1063,1138,1242,1320,1077,1002,1195,1167,1323,1317,1386,1207,1991,1512,1057,1630,1056,1014,1505,1012,1180,1246,1166,1243,1582,1089,1059,1920,1099,1143,1415,1735,1117,1055,1314,1622,1132,1101,1631,1132,1370,1130,1026,1188,1150,1200,1149,1685,1701,1019,1832,1832,1259,1002,1063,1063,1242,1688,1093,1015,1109,1038,1096,1002,1391,1063,1002,1113,1031,1372,1373; // Monsters ID
	setarray .@DropID[0],18743,19530,19716,19601,19600,19714,20017,20053,19848,19690,20164,20241,19824,19537,20127,19599,19763,19986,20160,31049,20037,20151,19832,20216,20294,20138,20322,20293,31054,20165,19821,20296,20020,19931,19533,19544,19548,19618,19666,19671,19707,19727,19758,19786,19818,19959,19960,20196,20253,20290,20297,20346,20381,20432,31326,31331,31332,31378,31387,31443,31444,31556,31562,31668,31720,19752,19611,19810,20221,20270,20295,20298,31167,31461,31617,31814,31853,410061,410099,410189,410193,20349,31482,31490,31585,31586,31616,19574; // Items ID
//	setarray .@Chance[0],10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10; // Drop Rate, as in percentage (100 = 1%)
	// End of Config
	for(set .@c,0; .@c < getarraysize(.@MobID); set .@c, .@c + 1) {
		if (killedrid == .@MobID[.@c]){
			set .@d, rand(1,1000);
			if (.@d <= 3) {	// Drop Rate, as in percentage (100 = 1%)
				getitem .@DropID[.@c],1;
				announce "[System] : " +strcharinfo(0) + " just obtained " + getitemname(.@DropID[.@c]) + "  from " + getmonsterinfo(.@MobID[.@c],MOB_NAME) + "!",BC_ALL;
			}
		}
	}
	end;
}

// MVP ID Backup
// setarray @MobID,1038,1039,1046,1150,15110,1647,1785,1630,1874,1272,
// 1719,1389,1112,1115,1418,18710,1252,1768,1086,1990,

prontera,164,170,4	script	Extra Drop Info	4_F_KAFRA1,{

	//--------------------------------------------------
	// CONFIG (MUST MATCH MobExtraDrops SCRIPT)
	//--------------------------------------------------
	setarray .MobID[0],
	1631,1261,1275,1736,1734,1688,1143,1115,1096,1418,2018,1093,1117,1259,
	1219,1837,1586,1063,1138,1242,1320,1077,1002,1195,1167,1323,1317,1386,
	1207,1991,1512,1057,1630,1056,1014,1505,1012,1180,1246,1166,1243,1582,
	1089,1059,1920,1099,1143,1415,1735,1117,1055,1314,1622,1132,1101,1631,
	1132,1370,1130,1026,1188,1150,1200,1149,1685,1701,1019,1832,1832,1259,
	1002,1063,1063,1242,1688,1093,1015,1109,1038,1096,1002,1391,1063,1002,
	1113,1031,1372,1373;

	setarray .DropID[0],
	18743,19530,19716,19601,19600,19714,20017,20053,19848,19690,20164,20241,
	19824,19537,20127,19599,19763,19986,20160,31049,20037,20151,19832,20216,
	20294,20138,20322,20293,31054,20165,19821,20296,20020,19931,19533,19544,
	19548,19618,19666,19671,19707,19727,19758,19786,19818,19959,19960,20196,
	20253,20290,20297,20346,20381,20432,31326,31331,31332,31378,31387,31443,
	31444,31556,31562,31668,31720,19752,19611,19810,20221,20270,20295,20298,
	31167,31461,31617,31814,31853,410061,410099,410189,410193,20349,31482,
	31490,31585,31586,31616,19574;

	.DropChance = 10; // same as kill script (10 / 1000 = 1%)

	//--------------------------------------------------
	// MAIN
	//--------------------------------------------------
	mes "[Extra Drop Information]";
	mes "Select a monster to see its extra drop.";
	next;

	.@menu$ = "";
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.MobID); .@i++) {
		.@menu$ += getmonsterinfo(.MobID[.@i], MOB_NAME) + ":";
	}
	.@sel = select(.@menu$) - 1;

	mes "[Extra Drop Information]";
	mes "Monster:";
	mes "^00FF00" + getmonsterinfo(.MobID[.@sel], MOB_NAME) + "^000000";
	mes "";
	mes "Extra Drop Item:";
	mes "^0000FF" + mesitemlink(.DropID[.@sel]) + "^000000";
	mes "";
	mes "Drop Chance:";
	mes (.DropChance) + " / 1000  (˜ 1%)";
	close;

OnInit:
	waitingroom "[ Costume Drop Info ]",0;
	end;
}
